_comment_channel: 'whatsapp' for India clients. 'sms' for US/Houston clients — Meta blocks WhatsApp marketing-category messages to US numbers, so proactive outbound must go over SMS there.

reengagement._comment: Weekly campaign to patients who haven't visited in 6+ months.
reengagement.smsBody: Hi {{firstName}}, it's been {{monthsLapsed}} months since your last visit to {{practiceName}}. We'd love to see you for a check-up — reply YES and we'll find you a slot.

receptionist._comment: AI phone receptionist. Answers calls 24/7, books appointments, escalates emergencies.

noShow._comment: Appointment reminders at 72h/24h/2h, plus waitlist auto-fill on cancellation.
noShow.smsBody: Reminder: your appointment at {{practiceName}} is on {{appointmentTime}}. Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule.

followUp._comment: Chases patients who were quoted treatment but never booked it. Max 3 touches.
followUp.smsBody: Hi {{firstName}}, you were recommended {{treatment}} ({{currencySymbol}}{{quotedPrice}}) at {{practiceName}}. Still interested? Reply YES to book.

reputation._comment: Asks for a rating after a visit. 4-5 stars are routed to Google, 1-3 stay private as internal feedback.
reputation.smsBody: Thanks for visiting {{practiceName}} today, {{firstName}}! How did we do? Reply with a number 1-5.

billing._comment: Monitors unpaid/stalled insurance claims and escalates by age. For India, repurpose as outstanding-balance follow-up.

booking._comment: Shared booking endpoint every other product calls. Single source of truth for appointments.
